handoff.summary: Build-to specification for DL1 flanged bushing complete and fully ledgered. CNC 6061-T6; through bore Ø20 H7 (sliding on given Ø20 h7 shaft, clearance 0–0.042 mm per fit_calc H7/h7, matches AC1/AC2); flange with 4×Ø4.5 clearance holes on PCD 34; envelope Ø50×25 mm; body Ø28×20 under 5 mm flange. Verification plan maps every AC.

spec.name: flanged_bushing

envelope.rationale: Flange OD 50 provides edge margin around PCD34 + Ø4.5 holes; overall length = body 20 + flange thickness 5

material.rationale: Excellent machinability for H7, adequate light-duty strength and corrosion resistance; mission silent so defaulted (ledger decision)

process.rationale: ISO 286 H7 (IT7) requires metal-cutting; FDM cannot hold sliding-fit band; resolve_process → cnc_mill

interfaces.name: shaft_bore
interfaces.notes: 0.5×45° chamfer both ends for lead-in; matches AC pass band exactly (fit_calc)

interfaces.name: flange_bolt_circle
interfaces.geometry: 4 through holes equally spaced on pitch circle, pattern centered on bore axis

functional_dimensions.name: bore_diameter
functional_dimensions.driver: sliding fit on Ø20 h7 shaft; clr 0–0.042

functional_dimensions.name: body_OD
functional_dimensions.driver: ~4 mm wall + radial clearance to bolt circle

spec.configuration: Flange at one end; cylindrical body projects axially; concentric through-bore; bolt pattern on flange face centered on bore axis. Free geometry (fillets, minor edges) left to modeler.
assumptions: No layout skeleton or mating housing provided; only AC interfaces constrained
Light-duty sliding service (no heavy radial load or lubrication groove specified)

handoff.reasoning_summary: Owned all interfaces for this first deliverable. Used recommend_fit + dual fit_calc: H7/h7 gives exactly the AC band [0,0.042] vs the given h7 shaft, so selected over classic H7/g6. Thread_spec confirmed M4 major 4 → Ø4.5 clearance. Process forced to CNC for H7. Free geometry (body/flange proportions) set by geometry rules and standard L/D, all ledgered with provenance before handoff.
